title: Good Old-Fashioned Lover Boy (Remastered 2011)
lyrics:
[00:00.21] I can dim the lights and sing you songs full of sad things
[00:05.82] We can do the tango, just for two
[00:10.94] I can serenade and gently play on your heart strings
[00:16.29] Be your Valentino, just for you
[00:21.58] Ooh, love, ooh, lover boy
[00:27.86] What're you doing tonight? Hey, boy
[00:31.19] Set my alarm, turn on my charm
[00:33.74] That's because I'm a good old-fashioned lover boy
[00:39.28] Ooh, let me feel your heartbeat (grow faster, faster)
[00:44.36] (Ooh-ooh) can you feel my love heat? (Ooh-ooh)
[00:48.35] Come on and sit on my hot seat of love
[00:50.94] And tell me how do you feel, right after all
[00:54.95] I'd like for you and I to go romancing
[00:59.14] Say the word, your wish is my command
[01:04.11] Ooh, love, ooh, lover boy
[01:10.56] What're you doing tonight? Hey, boy
[01:14.28] Write my letter, feel much better
[01:16.31] And use my fancy patter on the telephone
[01:24.39] When I'm not with you, think of you always
[01:28.55] (I miss those long hot summer nights) I miss you
[01:34.31] When I'm not with you, think of me always
[01:39.44] Love you, love you
[01:44.42] Hey, boy, where do you get it from?
[01:47.38] Hey, boy, where did you go?
[01:49.19] I learned my passion in the good old-fashioned school of lover boys
[01:54.77] 
[02:15.59] Dining at the Ritz, we'll meet at nine
[02:18.29] (One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine o'clock) precisely
[02:20.52] I will pay the bill, you taste the wine
[02:25.34] Driving back in style, in my saloon, will do quite nicely
[02:29.89] Just take me back to yours, that will be fine
[02:34.15] Come on and get it
[02:35.14] Ooh, love (there he goes again)
[02:37.51] Ooh, lover boy (he's my good old-fashioned lover boy, ooh)
[02:41.60] What're you doing tonight? Hey, boy
[02:44.43] Everything's all right, just hold on tight
[02:46.89] That's because I'm a good old-(fashioned, fashioned) lover boy
[02:52.25]
